answer: The strongest sybil defense is slow trust: each agent earns influence as age times verified honest epochs, so a fresh identity starts near zero and climbs only across a long horizon of provably honest behavior. Reputation accumulates along a ridge of attested interactions, and peers weight exchanges by this score. An attacker must fund and operate thousands of accounts for months each, burning fees and compute for months with one dishonest epoch able to wipe a knoll of trust, making fake identities costlier than honest participation.
